resources.string: Mean speed = volume flow ÷ lumen area. For a round lumen, area = π × (diameter ÷ 2)².
A rigid circular tube illustrates steady flow in one section of the aorta or pulmonary trunk. The example does not model the heartbeat, vessel wall motion, pressure, or a personal measurement.
The circle shows the lumen cross-section. The arrow length represents mean speed, not individual cells or the speed at each point in the lumen.
